Conditions shown from the report: the crashing probe (launched 20:22:31, binary uuid 0e14c0dd) was built from UNCOMMITTED source. Line 16236 of PlaytestHarness.swift at HEAD then (97b0a0e01) is a doc comment, and the top frames are CoreFoundation ___forwarding___.cold.5 called straight from pickUpTile. The session of a-walk-that-pulls-a-library-tile-by-hand-sees-it (transcript 0c46ebe3) shows that at 04:16Z it pasted diagnostic code into pickUpTile that looped objc_copyClassList and called NSStringFromClass on each class; its very next walk (04:22:49Z) printed this exact CRASHED line, and at 04:23Z it switched to class_getName and later removed all diagnostics before committing be6e82181.

Not reproducible on landed code: grep for objc_copyClassList / diag hooks in Sources finds nothing. Built the probe from HEAD bb0f48d7b and ran the four pick-up walks: tile-comes-away, text-style-comes-away and transition-tile-comes-away ok, no crash; title-presets-library-shelf-walk fails cleanly at step 25 because 1db5bdff4's short video shelf leaves Film Super half scrolled out (filed the-title-presets-walk-pulls-film-super-off-the, p2). No app code to fix and so no test: the crash was never in shipped code. crash-watch.json marks the report as a runner diagnostic.

left rough: crash-watch cannot tell a probe built from a runner's uncommitted experiment from landed code, so a runner's own diagnostic crash files a p1. First such case in crash-watch's history (the two earlier crash tasks were real bugs), so not filed; if it happens again, stamp the probe build with the git tree state and have crash-watch log a dirty-build crash on the running task instead.

Not an app bug: the probe that crashed at 20:22 was built from another runner's uncommitted diagnostic code in pickUpTile (NSStringFromClass over objc_copyClassList, trapping in ___forwarding___), shown from the report's line numbers and that runner's session, which hit this exact crash at 04:22Z and removed the code before committing be6e82181. On HEAD the pick-up walks run with no crash (3 ok; title presets walk fails cleanly on the new short shelf, filed the-title-presets-walk-pulls-film-super-off-the). crash-watch.json marks the report as a runner diagnostic.
